globalSettings.subtitle: Settings here apply to every model. To adjust a single model, go to Connect Management

record.affects: Affects: how much detail the call history keeps — only who called, or also the prompt and the answer.
record.when: When to change: "Metadata only" saves the most space. Raise it to "Summary" or "Full" only when you need to investigate a wrong answer.

lb.affects: Affects: which model takes a given request — picked at random, split by weight, or always the same one.
lb.when: When to change: usually leave it alone. If one model is overloaded, or you want traffic spread evenly across vendors, set the strategy per virtual model instead.

circuit.affects: Affects: after a model fails several times in a row, the gateway takes it out of rotation for a while so requests are not sent into a black hole.
circuit.when: When to change: turn it on when upstream providers are unstable. If the model recovers slowly, raise the failure threshold.

quota.affects: Affects: where usage is recorded, and whether requests are let through or rejected when the ledger errors out.
quota.when: When to change: to make hourly or monthly limits actually enforce, the ledger must be on. Leaving it off is fine if you only need the daily limit.

misc.affects: Affects: miscellaneous switches that have no dedicated tab yet — advanced pricing (enterprise) and PII sanitization.
misc.when: When to change: when you need tiered pricing, time-of-day pricing, separate cache-hit pricing, or want to adjust PII masking of call records.

pricingAdvanced.title: Advanced pricing
pricingAdvanced.description: When enabled, an "Advanced pricing rules" entry appears next to each unit price, allowing tiered, time-of-day and cache-hit differentiated pricing; when disabled, all billing uses the flat unit price.
pricingAdvanced.needBilling: Requires the enterprise billing license, which is not unlocked in this deployment; the switch is hidden.
pricingAdvanced.lockedHint: Enterprise feature: not included in this deployment (grayscale locked); the switch stays locked.
pricingAdvanced.hotHint: Changes take effect immediately (no restart needed); after a restart the value falls back to the static config. To keep it enabled, write it into the config file.
pricingAdvanced.loadFailed: Failed to load advanced pricing state

sanitization.title: PII Sanitization
sanitization.requestDesc: Mask PII (phone numbers, ID numbers, emails, etc.) in chat requests before they are written to call history and logs.
sanitization.responseDesc: Mask sensitive information in model answers before storage (forwarding to downstream providers is unaffected).
sanitization.hotHint: Changes take effect immediately (no restart needed); after a restart the value falls back to the static config. Rule details and dry-run live in the security management pages.

globalSettings.defaultsFooter: These are gateway-wide defaults. To adjust a single model, go to Connect Management → Model Management.
